description: create-skill-autoresearch: the kill guard blocks pattern kills (pkill, killall, pgrep-fed kill) in Bash calls, so stop owned jobs with scripts/run_owned.py; the subagent guard denies a background Agent dispatch inside a factory build (a headless session stops background subagents 10 minutes after its last turn), so phase workers and panel roles run in the foreground; the finish guard sends a factory build back once when the main session's turn ends (never a worker's or subagent's) while scripts/check_gate.py --finish fails
